title: Stop reporting task coverage as a delivered roadmap, and queue what is left
goal: susi tasks roadmap reports coverage: every one of the 102 vectors has a linked task and delivered means every linked task is closed. That reads as a finished roadmap while 30 vectors do not claim delivery in their own narrative (72 start DELIVERED:) and 29 of those have nothing queued, so once the eight swarm-gap tasks close the queue is empty with the work still outstanding. Report mastery separately from coverage (mastery_claimed and unqueued per vector, plus a --unqueued view), and make scripts/check-roadmap-queue.py fail while a vector that does not claim delivery has no open task, with --queue to file the verification task for each: prove the mastery target with a nonzero test or record what is missing.
